text:
tomas: hey team :wave: quick onboarding q. I'm wiring PR builds to call hosted sandbox. what's the recommended pattern for API key rotation in CI and do ephemeral keys support per-build creation via API? Also worried about exceeding per-project sandbox quotas.

 devex: welcome! Ephemeral keys are best for PR builds. You can create them in Console -> API Keys manually, or use the internal key-creation endpoint with a service account token if your infra allows it. Ephemeral keys expire (1-8h). For rotation: generate per-run, store in CI secret store, don't echo.

 security: noted: prefer ephemeral keys + short TTL and minimal scopes. If you automate key creation, make sure the service account has constrained perms and rotate the service account creds regularly. Also enable key audit logs for the project.

 tomas: does the ephemeral key API rate-limit? creating 100 keys/hr might be problematic.

 infra-ops: key creation has low-rate safeguards. If you need bulk per-build keys, batch creation or reuse short-lived keys for a build window. For load tests or many PRs, file a quota request (Console -> Usage -> Quota Requests) and mention key-creation cadence.

 tomas: thanks. about quotas: what's the safe per-project default so I can set retries?

 devex: defaults are conservative (~60 reqs/min) but vary. For resilience: implement exponential backoff with jitter, honor Retry-After, and surface failures for test runs. Set per-call max_tokens.

 infra-ops: if you need wider headroom, request temporary uplift with project id, time window, target rps, and CIDR if you want IP allowlist. We'll usually approve short windows for onboarding/tests.

 onboarding-bot: reminder: "Request sandbox quota" and "Create ephemeral key" checklist items pending for @tomas.

 tomas: filed request: https://console.redwood.ai/projects/dev-sandbox/usage/quota-requests (window 1770004800-1770008400 UTC, target 200 rps). created ephemeral key expiring 2h and updated CI. thanks all!

 security: one more tip: add a log-scrubber step to CI to redact any token-looking strings and scan build artifacts before publishing.

 devex: also pin model in requests and include a small test input to avoid long generation during runs. sample curl:

 ```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"open-redwood-1-small\",\"input\":\"smoke\",\"max_tokens\":200}'
```

 infra-ops: I'll watch the project during the window; ping here if you need expedite. Good luck!

 tomas: much appreciated :heart:
